subject: Re: Kickoff: linear-eval as the portfolio's representation check — June decisions
body:
Team,

Decisions for the Jun 12 close-out:

1. Standardization ships as planned: all three teams are on linear-eval, Evalline integration is live, and Paloma's dashboard makes val_accuracy vs test_accuracy comparisons across teams a one-screen story. Milestone met.
2. Distillation recipe: descoped from Jun 12 and carried into Q3 as its own OKR line with Efe at 50%. I'd rather ship a recipe teams trust than a quickstart that burns them; Efe's point about turnkey-ness settled it. Q3 planning locks Jun 26, and I've already penciled the line in.
3. Linnea's padding-mask validation gets upstreamed to our open-source release — small thing, saves someone real pain.

Thanks all — the 1.9pp discrepancy find alone justified this project.

Anders
